'''Shilly''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who live during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Shilly was among a group of couriers who traveled to a rendezvous point in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], to collect some illicit cargo. Shilly flew there in a custom [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that she owned, but she and her fellow couriers found the rendezvous point to be deserted. However, they were then ambushed by enforcers that were working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]]. Shilly and [[Gust Toruna]], one of the other couriers, fled in the speeder, but were pursued by gunmen on [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. The bikers were eventually able to blow up the speeder, killing Shilly.
